old_caption: The video depicts a woman performing a yoga pose on a dark exercise mat placed on a wooden floor. She is wearing a light-colored tank top and a teal towel wrapped around her waist. The setting appears to be a simple room with a plain gray wall and a large mirror leaning against it. The woman lies on her back with one leg extended upwards and bent at the knee, while the other leg remains straight and elevated. Her arms are positioned flat on the mat beside her body. The scene is well-lit, highlighting the woman's form. The background remains static throughout the video, focusing entirely on the woman's yoga practice.
original_wisa_caption: The video depicts a woman performing a yoga pose on a dark exercise mat placed on a wooden floor. She is wearing a light-colored tank top and a teal towel wrapped around her waist. The setting appears to be a simple room with a plain gray wall and a large mirror leaning against it. The woman lies on her back with one leg extended upwards and bent at the knee, while the other leg remains straight and elevated. Her arms are positioned flat on the mat beside her body. As the video progresses, she slowly lowers her extended leg towards the mat, maintaining a controlled and deliberate movement. The scene is well-lit, highlighting the woman's form and the smooth transition of her leg from an elevated position to a more relaxed state. The background remains static throughout the video, focusing entirely on the woman's yoga practice.
caption: The video depicts a woman on a gray yoga mat in a room with a plain wall, wooden floor, and tall mirror. She lies in a single-leg bridge, hips lifted, one knee bent and foot planted, arms flat beside her torso. Her head is turned to the side, and her other leg extends diagonally upward toward the upper left. The mirror reflects the same pose, showing the lifted hips, planted foot, and raised leg. For most of the excerpt, the body position is held steadily, with the raised leg straight and the supporting foot and torso fixed. Near the end, the raised leg changes position as the knee bends and the thigh rotates more upright, drawing the foot closer to vertical above the hip. The reflected image tracks this movement, showing the raised leg shift from extended to bent while the rest of the pose stays stable. The camera remains fixed, so the visible change comes from the woman's leg rather than view motion.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
